title: equisetum palustre f. fallax
intro: Equisetum palustre f. fallax, commonly known as Marsh Horsetail, is a type of plant that belongs to the Equisetaceae family and is a variant of Equisetum palustre. It is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe and protect the skin. The therapeutic actions of Marsh Horsetail include its ability to stimulate blood flow, reduce inflammation, and promote wound healing. Its bioactive constituents include silica, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
